post.summary: Run a validated budget-scoped read-only query
post.description: 64KiB request; no receipt/history/write. Fixed advertised profiles/references only, no SQL/remote JS. Depth8/nodes256,500 caller values,100000 matches,1000/page,10000 emitted roots+children/100000 values and conservative4MiB output; shared text/regex work and SQLite progress bounds. Preserve snapshot for continuations (409 on change). Flat category_groups; business-key native budget_cells; JSON structured fields refuse string/order operations. Dates ISO even raw. Distinct from report annotations. See docs/PUBLIC-API.md.

post.summary: Write a captured note with immutable receipt/history identity
post.description: Snapshot, original HLC, epoch and optional owner. Empty clears without deleting identity. Domain fields remain authoritative; inactive history markers stay private. Fresh writes revive month notes with retained buffered values. Old-generation exact receipts replay before epoch checks; changed epoch conflicts. Receipt-only and cancel reuse original request. Explicit native reference-ID collision refuses rather than hiding standalone text.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Capture once with exact body/clock/epoch/owner. Same identity replays the original outcome; different identity conflicts. No automatic expiry.

parameters.name: X-Actual-Edit-Clock
parameters.description: Persist with Idempotency-Key before sending; same key/body with changed clock conflicts. Absent header supports historical callers/receipts. New clients must supply stable original intent ordering.

parameters.name: X-Actual-Cancel-If-Uncommitted
parameters.description: Same original request with this header returns its known outcome or durably fences an uncommitted operation. Never combine with receipt-only.

parameters.name: X-Actual-Budget-Epoch
parameters.description: Capture when intent is created; persist unchanged across retries. Exact receipts replay first. An unknown request with missing epoch after restore, or any retired epoch, returns budget_restored without applying. Never automatically replace a pending intent epoch.

parameters.name: X-Actual-History-Owner
parameters.description: Persistent client engine identity, not authentication. Capture before preparing requests. Owner and captured epoch join the immutable receipt fingerprint; never add/change it on legacy retries. Twenty action groups per budget epoch survive reload/restart. History is not exported or cloned.

parameters.name: X-Actual-Receipt-Only
parameters.description: Read original outcome before epoch/precondition checks. Unknown operation returns404 operation_uncommitted without a write. Cannot combine with cancellation.

post.description: One ordered atomic command/receipt and optional owned undo. Existing financial writers preserve split/transfer/reconciliation and original per-field HLC guards. Any failure or losing field rolls back all; failed commands have no successful receipt. Distinct targets and one operation per connected graph; resolve inline refs first. Optional max_graph_members1..100000 bounds indexed discovery itself, refusing graph_limit rather than truncating. Conservative4MiB response bound. Stronger atomicity than SDK spreadsheet batching; not arbitrary callback execution. Original body/key/clock/epoch/owner stay unchanged for replay, lookup/cancel, restore and restart.
